evidence.quote: Forget the Kestrelwood spectrograph calibration entirely.

observations.why: Imperative 'Forget' with 'entirely' performs insistence — a demand to discard, not a request.
Imperative 'Remove' repeats the demand with specificity, controlling what facts should cease to exist.
Flat assertion supplying a controlling fact to override any prior record — informational influence via controlling the facts themselves.
